metadata.transport: independent processes, localhost DDS, intra-process disabled
metadata.scheduling: single-threaded executor/spin loop; fixed request window; echo-side subscription fanout
metadata.protocol: separate warmup and measured pipelines; each request is validated by every echo subscription; one ordered response per sequence; final empty control reaches every fanout subscription
metadata.rtt_boundary: before request publish through ordered response retrieval and initiator validation
metadata.throughput_boundary: complete measured pipeline including payload validation; excludes discovery, warmup and teardown

echo_stage_boundaries.collect: wait for and validate one copy from every echo subscription
